material_events.claim: TOP increased its Board from five to seven directors, appointing Dean Huge as Independent Director and Yuli Yan as Executive Director.

material_events.claim: TOP established its global headquarters at 4201 Main Street, Suite 200, Houston, Texas 77002, and restructured its Board and senior executive leadership, appointing Jennifer Hoi Ling Tam as Co-Chief Executive Officer.

Ms. Jennifer Hoi Ling Tam has been appointed as Co-Chief Executive Officer and Executive Director.

material_events.claim: TOP issued a press release addressing recent unusual fluctuations in its stock price, confirming business operations are progressing normally and no material undisclosed developments exist, and announced plans for an AI R&D Center in Silicon Valley.
